evidence.quote: The relevant dimensions are included in the PDF.
There is a set of measured drawings in PDF form in the Extras section. Print this for reference while building.

R1.reason: The Leg and False Drawer Front cutout shapes (templates, steps 1-6) have no dimensions in the plan text or cut list; they are only in the Extras PDF. The viewed step-1 image shows a drawing page too small to read and the arch outline on MDF with no numbers. The base and drawers can still be built from the cut list, so Fix level.

R2.reason: Searched steps for each cut-list part: 'Center Support' is called 'Center Divider' (steps[9], steps[13]); 'End' is called 'Legs' (steps[3], steps[12]). Step 29 trim is an adjustment of False Drawer Front, not a new part. Templates come from 1/4 in MDF listed in materials[3].

R3.reason: Flag rejected: cutList[4] 'Center Support' is the 'Center Divider' of steps[9] and steps[13] ('The Center Divider gets installed next').

R4.basis: Kreg-corrected cut rows vs board materials (§9)

R5.reason: R5 precondition not met: 3 stock types (sheet-0.75, sheet-0.5, sheet-0.25); steps not checked for per-part stock

R6.reason: Flag rejected: steps[11] '1-1/4” coarse thread Kreg Screws' matches materials[4] '1-1/4 Pocket Screws - Box' (no inch mark in the name). Micro 3/4 in screws materials[6] for 1/2 in drawer plywood; #8 x 1 and #6 x 1 screws in materials[10], [11]. No conflicting sizes found.

R10.reason: Flags settled: slide position is set by a 3 in spacer and the front offset equals the False Front thickness (steps[24], image viewed shows the spacer against the Leg); Leg Braces 'offset from the front of the Legs by 1-1/2”' on 5-7/8 in spacers (steps[14]); Top pocket holes '7 per side' evenly spaced (steps[8]); Center Divider centered (relational, steps[13]); groove 1/4 in blade height and fence (steps[18]). Steps[29] trim 1/16-1/8 in is a reveal, not a position. Steps[15], [32] are not placements.

R11.reason: The three 'diagram/drawings' references (steps[0], [1], [13]) are each backed by text values: cut list sizes, 'it just gets centered', step 1 image shows the drawing page. Missing cutout dimensions are recorded under R1.

R8.reason: Order is possible: parts cut (steps 0-6) before pocket holes (7-10), Top Trim/Legs/Divider/Braces assembled (11-14), drawers built (17-23) before slides/fronts are installed (24-31). Drawer Front/Back are deliberately cut long and trimmed in step 20 after the grooves.

evidence.quote: The joinery construction for the base is all pocket holes.
Drill pocket holes on either end of each Drawer Front/Back, being sure to stay clear of the grooves we cut earlier.

R9.reason: Searched all steps/materials for /setting|collar|thickness/ with a jig setting: none stated for 3/4 in or 1/2 in plywood. The viewed step-7 image shows the jig and drill but no readable setting. Recorded only (R9 not counted).

evidence.quote: There is also a link to the Duplo build plates in Extras.

R14.reason: Searched steps, cut list, description for /duplo|build plate|plate/i: only steps[32] (a purchase mention). No step attaches or fits the four build plates to the Top, so the steps end without installing a listed component the table is for. Level Fix: the table, drawers and top are all built.

gaps.quote: Attach the templates to the work pieces using two-sided tape.
gaps.what: two-sided tape is not in materials

gaps.quote: drill 4 holes in the front of each drawer. These will accept the screws that hold the False Fronts in place.
gaps.what: No hole position on the drawer front is given (only the count of 4 and 'slightly oversized'); position is only settled by the clamped false front, so recorded as a note, not a failed check.
